cloud_ioc.description: Qakbot is a worm that spreads through network shares and removable drives. It downloads additional files, steals information, and opens a back door on the compromised computer. The worm also contains rootkit functionality to allow it to hide its presence. A command or file path similar to one used by Qakbot for spreading across the network or persistence was seen.
